stories.title: USA luden offenbar Israel und arabische Staaten zu Treffen in Deutschland ein

en.title: USA apparently invited Israel and Arab states to meeting in Germany
en.summary: Senior military officials from the United States, Israel, and Arab states reportedly met in Germany to discuss ongoing tensions related to Iran, with the United States organizing the gathering.

stories.title: DDR-Opposition: Mitbegründer der Ost-SPD: Martin Gutzeit gestorben

en.title: East German Opposition: Co-founder of East SPD Martin Gutzeit dies
en.summary: Martin Gutzeit, a co-founder of the East German SPD during the opposition period, has died.

en.title: Author Dörte Hansen / "Broder": North German village talent
en.summary: Dörte Hansen's new novel "Broder" portrays rural North German life impressively. The author reports that her writing process remains slow and she continues to have reservations about her work despite four completed novels.

stories.title: Jeff Bezos: Österreichische Polizei schickt Personenschutz für Double von Amazon-Gründer

en.title: Jeff Bezos: Austrian police deploy protection for Amazon founder's double
en.summary: Austrian authorities provided police protection for a Bezos lookalike at a private company event, leading to consequences. The incident reveals a close relationship between the company chief and the head of Linz police.

stories.title: Huthi-Miliz: Huthis melden neue Angriffe auf Saudi-Arabien

en.title: Houthi militia: Houthis report new attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The Houthi militia claims to have attacked an oil facility and military base in Saudi Arabia, while denying allegations of an attack on Mecca.

stories.title: CDU: Friedrich Merz - was hinter der Solidaritätsadresse der Ministerpräsidenten steckt

en.title: CDU: Friedrich Merz - what lies behind the minister-presidents' solidarity address
en.summary: Eight CDU-led state premiers oppose discussions about minority governments and personnel changes, providing Chancellor Merz with political support, at least for now.

stories.title: Newsblog zur Bundespolitik: Bas legt verspäteten Aktionsplan gegen Sozialmissbrauch vor

en.title: News blog on federal politics: Bas presents delayed action plan against social welfare abuse
en.summary: An action plan intended to prevent organized misuse of social benefits, originally due in July, is now being coordinated within the government, with contentious points already anticipated.

stories.title: CDU-Ministerpräsidenten stellen sich hinter Kanzler Merz - dazu Matthias Deiß, ARD Berlin

en.title: CDU minister-presidents stand behind Chancellor Merz - with Matthias Deiß, ARD Berlin
en.summary: CDU-led state premiers express support for Chancellor Merz.

stories.title: Drohne über Litauen war laut Regierung mit Sprengstoff bestückt

en.title: Drone over Lithuania was equipped with explosives according to government
en.summary: Lithuania shot down a drone that authorities say was carrying explosives. Similar incidents involving aircraft in NATO territory are increasing, with Poland also reporting a suspected Russian drone.

stories.title: Regierung legt Aktionsplan gegen Sozialbetrug vor

en.title: Government presents action plan against social benefit fraud
en.summary: The federal government is strengthening measures against misuse of welfare benefits through an action plan featuring increased data sharing, more inspections, stricter regulations, and artificial intelligence applications.

stories.title: Gemeinsame Erklärung: CDU-Ministerpräsidenten stellen sich hinter Merz

en.title: Joint statement: CDU state premiers stand behind Merz
en.summary: All eight CDU state premiers issued a joint declaration supporting Chancellor Merz, who faces considerable pressure ahead of state elections in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin.

stories.title: Drohne über Litauen: Der Krieg trifft auch NATO-Mitglieder

en.title: Drone over Lithuania: The war also affects NATO members
en.summary: The downing of a drone from Belarus over Lithuania represents the latest incident in a concerning series of events affecting NATO territory.

stories.title: Märkte Insight: Die Kryptobranche verliert ihren wichtigsten Kurstreiber

en.title: Markets Insight: The crypto industry loses its most important price driver
en.summary: A law significant for the cryptocurrency sector has failed, causing notable market reactions. The market must now reorganize itself under more challenging conditions.

stories.title: Deep Read: Die Wellenbrecherin – wie sich Manuela Schwesig der AfD entgegenstellt

en.title: Deep Read: The Wave Breaker – how Manuela Schwesig stands up to the AfD
en.summary: An SPD politician has mounted a remarkable comeback effort against the AfD. If she succeeds in stopping the far-right party's advance on Sunday, she will become indispensable within the SPD.

stories.title: Handelsblatt-Konferenz: Finanzaufsicht Bafin sieht bei Versicherern Verbesserungsbedarf bei Datennutzung in KI-Systemen

en.title: Handelsblatt Conference: Financial Regulator BaFin Sees Need for Improvement Among Insurers in Data Use in AI Systems
en.summary: Germany's financial regulator BaFin has identified gaps in how insurance companies justify the data they use in artificial intelligence applications. The regulator is calling on insurers to provide better explanations for their data selection in AI systems.

stories.title: Milliarden-Deal: Fokussierung auf KI-Chips: Infineon verkauft Teil seines Speichergeschäfts

en.title: Billion-euro deal: Focusing on AI chips: Infineon sells part of memory business
en.summary: Infineon is selling a memory division to Taiwanese chipmaker Winbond for approximately one billion euros. The company aims to redirect resources toward growth areas including AI chip development.
